title: SabasSpeedIndicator
description: This mod is a two in one speed indicator and speed on join mod with a cool menu.
body:
# ⚡ Saba Speed Indicator

A lightweight and highly customizable utility mod featuring a **Speed Indicator** and **Auto Sprint on Join**, all managed through a clean and optimized settings menu.

Designed to be simple, fast, and performance-friendly while giving you the information you need without cluttering your screen.

## ✨ Features

### 🏃 Speed Indicator

Monitor your movement speed in real time with a customizable HUD.

#### 📊 Display Modes

- 📝 Text Mode
- 🏎️ Speedometer Mode

#### 🎨 Customization

- 📍 Move the indicator anywhere on your screen
- 📏 Resize the HUD
- 🔢 Toggle decimal precision
- 👁️ Enable or disable it anytime

### ⚡ Auto Sprint on Join

Automatically enables sprint whenever you join a world or server.

- ✅ One-click toggle
- ⚙️ Fully customizable
- 🚀 Runs automatically in the background

### 🎨 Optimized Menu

A clean and intuitive configuration menu built for quick access.

- 🖱️ Simple navigation
- ⚡ Fast adjustments
- 🪶 Lightweight design
- 🎯 No unnecessary clutter

## 📦 Included

- ✅ Speed Indicator
- ✅ Text & Speedometer Display Modes
- ✅ Auto Sprint on Join
- ✅ Fully Customizable HUD
- ✅ Optimized Settings Menu
- ✅ Lightweight & Performance Friendly

## 🚀 Why Choose Saba Speed Indicator?

- ⚡ Lightweight and optimized
- 🎨 Easy to customize
- 🖥️ Clean modern interface
- 🏃 Perfect for PvP, parkour, speedrunning, and everyday gameplay
- 💨 Built to stay simple without sacrificing useful features

### Simple. Fast. Customizable.

**Saba Speed Indicator** gives you everything you need to monitor your speed and automatically sprint, while keeping your Minecraft experience clean, minimal, and optimized.
